rules.old:
LogError("%s: inconsistent accepted transaction undo at height %d, tx=%s\n",
                 __func__, height, tx.GetId().ToString())
rules.replacement: LogErrorEvent(BCLog::ALL, "coinstats_accepted_undo_inconsistent", "{source_function}: inconsistent accepted transaction undo at height {height}, tx={txid}").Field(BCLog::LogField::SourceFunction, __func__).Field(BCLog::LogField::Height, height).Field(BCLog::LogField::TxId, tx.GetId())
